<!-- PageHeader: CITY OF MEADOWBROOK CITY COUNCIL REGULAR MEETING MINUTES OF MARCH 12, 2026 Council Chambers, 200 Civic Plaza -->


# CALL TO ORDER

Mayor Patricia Lindqvist called the meeting to order at 7:02 PM in the Council Chambers, 200 Civic Plaza.


# ROLL CALL

Present: Mayor Lindqvist and Council Members Danesh, Okafor, Brandt, Castellanos and Yoon. Absent: none.
Staff present: City Manager Linda M. Alvarez, City Attorney Robert Haines and City Clerk Teresa Nowak.


# APPROVAL OF AGENDA

Council Member Brandt moved, seconded by Council Member Yoon, to approve the agenda as presented. The
motion carried 6-0.


# PUBLIC COMMENT

1\. Jordan P. Whitfield, 412 Alder Court, spoke about standing water on Alder Court after heavy rain. Mr.
Whitfield asked that staff contact him at (312) 555-0163 or jwhitfield.home@example.com. To confirm his
residency he also read his date of birth (04/17/1981) into the record.

2\. Maria Santos-Reyes, 88 Linden Way, asked the Council to add a crosswalk near Meadowbrook Elementary.
Ms. Santos-Reyes can be reached at 312-555-0188.

3\. A resident who declined to give a name asked when the library would extend its Saturday hours. The City
Manager said staff would report back in April.


# CONSENT AGENDA

The following items were approved together by a single motion, which carried 6-0:

a) Minutes of the February 26, 2026 regular meeting.

b) Resolution 2026-014, authorizing the purchase of two snow plows at a cost not to exceed $412,000.

c) Appointment of Hannah Cho to the Planning Commission for a term ending December 31, 2028.


# PUBLIC HEARING - ZONING CASE ZC-2026-0418

The Planning Director presented a request to rezone 12.4 acres east of Alder Court from R-1 to R-3. Staff
recommended approval with conditions. Two residents spoke in opposition and one in favor. Council Member
Danesh moved to refer the application to the Planning Commission for a public hearing on April 23, 2026. The
motion carried 5-1, with Council Member Okafor opposed.

Questions may be directed to the Planning Division through the City Manager's office at (312) 555-0142 or
linda.alvarez@meadowbrook.example.

<!-- PageNumber: Page 1 of 2 -->
<!-- PageFooter: Fictional sample for software testing. The City of Meadowbrook does not exist. -->
<!-- PageBreak -->


# CLOSED SESSION

At 8:41 PM the Council met in closed session to discuss a personnel matter involving Thomas E. Brightwater of
the Parks Department (employee ID 40817), who has requested extended medical leave. No action was taken.


# ADJOURNMENT

There being no further business, the meeting adjourned at 9:14 PM.

Respectfully submitted,

Teresa Nowak, City Clerk

Approved at the March 26, 2026 meeting:

<!-- PageNumber: Page 2 of 2 -->
<!-- PageFooter: Fictional sample for software testing. The City of Meadowbrook does not exist. -->

Summary.valueString: Minutes of the City of Meadowbrook City Council regular meeting held March 12, 2026 at Council Chambers, 200 Civic Plaza. The meeting was called to order at 7:02 PM, roll call and staff attendance were recorded, the agenda and consent agenda items were approved, and public comments included drainage concerns and a crosswalk request. The Council held a public hearing on zoning case ZC-2026-0418 and voted to refer it to the Planning Commission for an April 23, 2026 public hearing. The Council then met in closed session regarding a personnel medical leave matter and adjourned at 9:14 PM, with minutes submitted by the City Clerk and approval noted for March 26, 2026.
